what: acceptance-public-surfaces allows an integration test to drive a public library function besides the CLI, HTTP or UI.
why: Owner rule after the pilot 1 run (Tom, 2026-10-20, PR #54): integration tests may enter through a public library function, e.g. pilot 1's build_context(); end-to-end tests and just qc still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI. ADR 0002 was rewritten in place and the spec followed it (owner yes: Tom, 2026-10-20).
evidence: Pilot 1 run: a target whose public surface is a library function could not be integration-tested under 'the test drives the app's CLI, HTTP or UI and calls no internal function', which contradicted rewritten ADR 0002.

what: An owed eval is listed in its own file under docs/owed-evals/ instead of docs/future.md; the criterion's requirement (a smoke in evidence/ and a listed owed eval until just qa runs it) is unchanged.
why: Owner, issue #80 (finding 50): every lane appending to docs/future.md made nearly every pair of open PRs conflict there (#49/#73, #49/#78, #73/#78, #27/#35, #27/#31). ADR 0008 and check-behavior-smoke move to docs/owed-evals/ in the same PR; the spec follows.
evidence: Two contradicting lines once this PR lands: docs/adr/0008-prose-last.md (corrected in place, issue #80) and scripts/check-behavior-smoke require a docs/owed-evals/*.md change, while quality#acceptance-prompt-eval and #quality-prompt-smoke said docs/future.md.

what: Code review runs in parallel with just qc on the same head; just qc's judge is a qc judge from its own role; the code reviewer judges code quality only and blocks only on a documented standards breach or a named simplification.
evidence: Two contradicting lines once this PR lands: docs/adr/0022 (corrected in place, issue #67 item 9) and agents/qc-judge.md against quality#qaqc-when 'then code review of the head qc left' and #recipe-qc 'a fresh code reviewer run headless'.

what: just check in the kit no longer checks GitHub-only references: the Linear ban leaves check-refs.
why: Owner ruling (2026-10-22, issue #82): the kit works with Linear directly so it can run on a Linear-first repository; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'Pi-only and GitHub-only references' (recipe-check); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target.

what: recipe-check says plainly that just check has no Linear ban, since a target may choose Linear (ADR 0004).
why: Owner direction (2026-10-22, issue #82, before Accept): schpet/linear-cli (ISC, release v3.1.0), the CLI octo-lite uses, ships its own agent skill; vendor it and keep the kit's linear tracker skill to the seven fixed scripts as thin CLI wrappers.
evidence: The justfile check-refs fails on any 'Linear' reference ('check-refs: Linear references above; GitHub Issues is the tracker (docs/adr/0004)') while corrected ADR 0004 makes Linear a target's tracker.
